setup: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE orders AS SELECT *, (order_id * 0.000000000000000001 + 1.25)::DECIMAL(38, 18) AS d FROM orders
input.pql: PREDICT SUM(orders.price, 0, 30, days) FOR EACH users.user_id

expect.today: recorded at the reference 6298913c on DuckDB, SQLite and Postgres: orders.d, 80 values distinct as decimals and all 1.25 as float64, is float64 and categorical

why: A scaled DECIMAL column whose values differ only past float64's precision: the reference casts a decimal of scale > 0 to float64 before counting distinct values (one value, so categorical); the core counts the exact decimals (80 of 80, so numerical). The decimal stype fix riding along in T2.14b
